what: Photo pairs split into left and right halves of the plate switch to the next pair every 6 seconds — the new pair is laid on top and fills from bottom to top with clip-path (inset 100% 0 0 0 → 0) over 1s cubic-bezier(.7,0,.3,1), the right half .3s later, and the old pair stays 3s then clears on the same curve. On first open two accent-color curtains lift upward on the same 1s curve (second one .3s later). On phones (768px and below) the halves stack vertically and open from right to left, and the curtains exit to the left

options.every: Interval to the next pair (s), default 6
options.start: Delay after sticking before flipping starts (s), default .3 — first flip at start + every
options.lag: Delay for the second half and second panel (sec), default .3
options.hold: Dwell time (seconds) before the old pair lifts away, default 3
options.ease: Curve — in a form like ”0.7,0,0.3,1” or a CSS name (ease, linear), default cubic-bezier(.7,0,.3,1)
options.[data-fx-part=slide]: One photo pair — two halves inside
options.[data-fx-part=half]: Half-size photos (two per pair, one is fine)
options.[data-fx-part=veil]: (if present) accent-color curtain that lifts on first open — one empty div
